items.name: allocate_buffer
notes: The source says element values must be > 0 while also saying every element is initialized to 0. Both statements were retained without changing the source semantics.

sourceCorrections.detail: Corrected size > 0/element-value wording to a byte length >= 0, including the empty-buffer case and zero initialization. The maintained implementation rejects only negative lengths and lengths over CONFIG_INT(__MAX_BUFFER_SIZE__). This supersedes the initial decision to retain the source contradiction.

Removed the obsolete universal-default claim of 400000. The prose now identifies the runtime maximum buffer size setting as the authority. The checked driver default is 1 << 20 bytes (1048576), but no version-independent numeric default is advertised.

items.name: author_stats
notes: The source key list repeats errors, while its example and following explanation include objects. The discrepancy was preserved rather than corrected.

sourceCorrections.detail: Replaced only the final duplicate errors key in the introductory list with objects. get_info emits exactly moves, errors, heart_beats, array_size, objects; the existing five-key example remains unchanged. No cost or worth keys from divergent reference prose were added.

items.name: catch
notes: The source describes throw() as raising an error and returning a nonzero value. This wording was preserved without inferring different runtime behavior.

sourceCorrections.detail: Corrected control flow: throw() does not return; the nearest enclosing catch() returns the thrown value unchanged. Distinguished driver error strings with a leading asterisk from arbitrary thrown values, including the indistinguishable throw(0) case. Kept existing language-construct context without changing signatures or source facts.

items.name: filter_array
notes: The source spells one reference filter_arry() and specifies a filter result of 1. Both were retained rather than silently repaired.

sourceCorrections.detail: Changed the keep condition from a result equal to 1 to a nonzero/truthy result, matching !IS_ZERO(v). Parameter order, extra arguments and the subset result were retained.
Corrected the plain-prose typo filter_arry() to filter_array() in both locales. No signature, arity, example or Markdown inline-code token was altered.

items.name: get_garbage
notes: The source phrase about not mapping other objects and object->super is underspecified. Translation preserves it without adding ownership or lifecycle rules.

sourceCorrections.detail: Replaced the ambiguous map/no-inventory description with the actual garbage_check predicate: ref == 1 and O_CLONE, plus super/shadowing checks selected by NO_ENVIRONMENT/NO_SHADOWS. Explicitly avoided inventing an independent inventory predicate. Retained the MAX_ARRAY_SIZE truncation and introduction version; initial notes about retaining the original ambiguity are superseded.
